log.reply:
**Subject: Executive Briefing proposal for Tamarack Instruments**

Dear Dana Whitfield,

**Situation**

Tamarack Instruments designs and manufactures laboratory measurement instruments. It is headquartered in the Netherlands and operates in the Netherlands, Germany and the United States. The Client has deployed a customer service chatbot on its support portal, is piloting AI visual inspection on the German production line and plans AI sales forecasting next year. Its AI maturity is at the piloting stage. Your stated objective is: "I want governance in place before visual inspection goes into production in Q2 2027." Three constraints apply:

- Customer data must stay in the EU.
- The German works council is consulted before anything touches production staff.
- Budget is approved up to US$80,000 this fiscal year.

ISO/IEC 42001 work is targeted to start next year, with the start date not yet fixed.

**What the Briefing covers for Tamarack Instruments**

The Briefing maps the EU AI Act and GDPR to the three use cases. Regulatory points are framed as expectations to verify with counsel, not legal advice. United States obligations appear only as a general landscape item, because no US driver has been identified for the Client.

The readiness discussion tests visual inspection against the Q2 2027 objective. The operating model segment draws on the GRC Workbook (https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) and the Slow AI Kitchen (https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen). Board-layer reference comes from AI Governance for Boards (https://github.com/rolldabones/ai-governance-for-boards). The session also shows how this groundwork relates to ISO/IEC 42001. It does not promise certification, audit outcomes or regulatory approval. Three principles guide the session: Slow AI, Informed Intent and Final Liability rests with the Human.

**Logistics and price**

The Executive Briefing is a two-hour live virtual session for executive leadership and board-level attendees, priced at US$3,000. The roles named for the session are General Counsel, CISO, Head of Quality, Head of Data, German plant manager and two internal auditors.

**What you receive afterward**

You receive a follow-up memo covering:

- decisions surfaced in the session
- readiness observations
- three prioritized recommendations, each mapped to a next program option with a proposed timeline

**Next step**

The decision timeline is not yet known. Please confirm the following at intake:

1. Which governance frameworks, if any, the Client currently uses.
2. Whether the chatbot's data handling falls within the EU data residency constraint.
3. Whether the visual inspection pilot requires works council consultation.
4. Your preferred session date.

Kind regards,

Senior AI Governance Consultant
AI Governance Academy

Human-made, for Easy Work, Simply Done.
